Package com.signalwire.sdk.relay

Class RelayEvent

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.relay.RelayEvent
Direct Known Subclasses:
RelayEvent.AuthorizationStateEvent, RelayEvent.CallCollectEvent, RelayEvent.CallConnectEvent, RelayEvent.CallDetectEvent, RelayEvent.CallDialEvent, RelayEvent.CallFaxEvent, RelayEvent.CallPayEvent, RelayEvent.CallPlayEvent, RelayEvent.CallReceiveEvent, RelayEvent.CallRecordEvent, RelayEvent.CallReferEvent, RelayEvent.CallSendDigitsEvent, RelayEvent.CallStateEvent, RelayEvent.CallStreamEvent, RelayEvent.CallTapEvent, RelayEvent.CallTranscribeEvent, RelayEvent.ConferenceEvent, RelayEvent.MessagingReceiveEvent, RelayEvent.MessagingStateEvent, RelayEvent.QueueEvent
public class RelayEvent extends Object
Base class for all RELAY events.

Events arrive as signalwire.event messages with nested params: 

 {
   "params": {
     "event_type": "calling.call.play",
     "timestamp": 123457.1234,
     "params": { "call_id": "...", "control_id": "...", "state": "finished" }
   }
 }
Subclasses provide typed access to specific event payloads.
